title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #8 OPERATION DAWNSEEKER OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #8 OPERATION DAWNSEEKER OPEN
DURATION: August 30, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 13, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10
SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary."
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON " SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
0011 Tempest Series - Glen Sonata for Asbestos
Icefield Messenger Collection - Cheerful Guardian for Cardigan (Re-edition)
Season #8 Furniture – Dawnseeker Pennant
- Season #8 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
DURATION: August 30, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 13, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
NOTE:
You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

Compared with Season #7, Season #8 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site, and the Permanent Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The first Rotating Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
Several new Contracts and challenges will be added to the Season's Permanent Site on September 6, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7).
After Season #8 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
After Season #8 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Dawnseeker Supplies. The ratio is 1:1.
During Season #8, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
During Season #8, players can obtain Season #8 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 SUPPLIES & CHIPS EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: August 30, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 13, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies and Chips stay open during the period above.
03 NEW ANNIHILATION – HILLOCK COUNTRYSIDE
UPDATE TIME: September 5, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-8
DETAILS: South Prison will be replaced by New Annihilation Mission Hillock Countryside. South Prison will be added to the list of Hypothetical Annihilation Targets after it ends.
04 RECORD RESTORATION: STORIES OF AFTERNOON
UPDATE TIME: August 30, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The Record Restoration of Stories of Afternoon will be open after the next update. The limited event rewards will be permanently available for players to unlock.
